title: Study of Betaferon Adherence in Patients With Multiple Sclerosis Treated With Interferon Beta-1b
brief_summary: The primary objective of the study is to evaluate the adherence to the treatment with interferon beta-1b, in patients diagnosed with isolated syndrome (CIS), relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS), or secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (SPMS) who had more than 6 months in treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with relapsing-remitting MS (RRMS), secondary progressive MS (SPMS) or patients with a first outbreak or clinically isolated syndrome (CIS) that carry more than 6 months in treatment with interferon beta-1b

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
study_population: This study included patients who had been on interferon beta-1b for more than 6 months and who agreed to participate in this study.
